name: codex-usage-widget
description: A shared Flutter desktop companion for current Codex quota, reset timing, plan, account, and system capacity on macOS and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Track current Codex quota in a Flutter desktop companion.
interface.longDescription: Quota Bubble provides one Flutter desktop HUD for macOS and Windows. It reads the signed-in account locally, requests current quota data from Codex, stays pinned when needed, remembers its position, hides without quitting, and displays quota, balance, reset credits, account, subscription, and system capacity information.
